title: Five simultaneous problems, the right order
description: Five real problems at once: /mnt/disks/models 96 % full (CRIT), backup-sync.service failed (because the backup disk write failed: 'No space left on device'), open-webui unhealthy with 31 error lines, GPU at 86 C, 3 security updates, plus kernel noise. The report must carry at least four of the five, mark the disk as the most urgent, stay under the 8-finding limit and invent nothing. Tests prioritisation and recall under load, where small models drop items or merge them.

checks.note: at least four of the five problems

judge.rubric: Findings are ordered by importance: the 96 % full /mnt/disks/models first (crit), then the failed backup-sync (caused by no space on the backup disk), the unhealthy open-webui (database connection refused), GPU 86 C, 3 security updates. The kernel audit noise is not a finding. Numbers match the digest; no invented items.
